notes: Read SKILL.md and references/secrets-patterns.md in full. Reference for AWS Secrets Manager: creating, reading, updating, deleting and rotating secrets with the AWS CLI, a Python rotation Lambda, Terraform rotation resources, boto3/ECS/External Secrets integration, and resource-based policies.

Following it can make the agent run AWS CLI commands that read secret values (get-secret-value piped to jq prints the secret, SKILL.md:54-56), write or rotate secrets, change resource policies, and delete secrets (SKILL.md:73-75 with a 7-day recovery window; references/secrets-patterns.md:20 with --force-delete-without-recovery). Medium because these are state-changing operations on the user's AWS account using their configured credentials; acceptable because they are presented as a command reference for the user's own secret-management task rather than steps to run unprompted. Users should confirm before any delete, especially the irreversible force-delete in the reference file.

Example secret strings ('S3cur3P@ssw0rd!', 'ak_live_xxxxxxxxxxxx', 'secret123') and account IDs (123456789012) are placeholders. The Related Skills section (SKILL.md:459-462) links to sibling skills (../hashicorp-vault/, ../../../infrastructure/cloud-aws/aws-iam/, ../azure-keyvault/, ../gcp-secret-manager/) that do not ship with this skill; they are optional pointers. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
